blocks.text: The Zscaler and RedSeal Deployment Guide explains how to integrate Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) with RedSeal Network.
RedSeal Network brings complex hybrid on-premises and multi-cloud networks into one, comprehensive, dynamic visualization. RedSeal Network allows you to :

blocks.item: Quickly identify gaps in your infrastructure.
Leverage bi-directional integration and vulnerability scanners to quickly identify scan coverage.
Ensure your critical resources aren’t exposed to the internet.
Continuously verify compliance mandates according to industry best practices.
